evidence_excerpts: Tables 2 through 4 show 1464 bzip2 callsites in the full log comparison, no choices with yes consensus, and after a 45% alignment cut only 15 FDO choices without consensus in the high-cut group but 545 FDO choices without consensus in the low-cut group.
text: For bzip2 on Itanium, inlining logs split into a high-alignment group with similar decisions and a low-alignment group with substantially different callsite choices and no universally inlined callsite.
